latest.title: Weekend Annoying Task Challenge: CureBot AI
latest.description: CureBot AI is a serverless health assistant built on AWS that simplifies the repetitive task of searching multiple websites for basic health guidance. Users can ask everyday health questions and receive fast, AI-powered responses through Amazon Bedrock. Powered by AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amplify, and CloudWatch, CureBot delivers a scalable, responsive, and user-friendly experience while encouraging users to seek professional medical advice when necessary.

latest.title: Weekend Annoying Task Challenge: CodeLift AI
latest.description: CodeLift AI automates the repetitive first pass of understanding an unfamiliar project by turning a ZIP upload into a clear, structured codebase report. The app combines a React frontend with AWS S3, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and Amazon Bedrock to make project triage faster and easier.

latest.title: Padrão Strangler Fig: Modernização de Monolitos com AWS Migration Hub Refactor Spaces e API Gateway
latest.description: O artigo detalha a implementação do Padrão Strangler Fig utilizando o AWS Migration Hub Refactor Spaces para orquestrar roteamento transparente na borda da nuvem. Direcionado a arquitetos de soluções seniores, o material orienta a construção de fachadas estranguladoras (Strangler Facades), a delegação de tráfego intercontas via AWS Transit Gateway e a implementação de Camadas de Anticorrupção (ACL) baseadas em Arquitetura Hexagonal, assegurando migrações progressivas com tempo de inatividade zero.

latest.title: Zero Surprises: From Firefighting to Proactive Ops with AWS DevOps Agent
latest.description: Learn how to combine AI-powered incident investigation with specialist human collaboration to reduce mean time to resolve from 90 minutes to under 10 — using a reusable convergence model where DevOps Agent analyzes root cause at T+0 while your team converges with context ready, not from scratch.

latest.title: Why I Built an AI Agent to Read My AWS Bill For Me
latest.description: InfraLens is an AI-powered AWS cost intelligence agent that helps you understand why your cloud bill changed, not just what changed. Using live AWS APIs and agentic reasoning, it analyzes costs, detects anomalies, and correlates them with infrastructure activity to surface actionable insights in plain English.

latest.title: Getting Started on AWS for Startups: Build Right from Day One
latest.description: If you're a founder standing up your app on AWS for the first time, the choices you make in your first hour matter more than almost any architecture decision you'll make later. This guide walks you through a pragmatic, founder-friendly path to set up your AWS environment *the right way on day one*.  You don't need to be deeply technical to follow along — the goal is simply to avoid the handful of mistakes that are painful and expensive to unwind later.

trending.title: Understanding Amazon Web Services (AWS)
trending.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a cloud computing platform developed by Amazon that provides a wide range of on-demand services, including computing power, storage, databases, networking, and security. It enables individuals and organisations to build, manage, and scale applications without investing in expensive physical infrastructure. AWS is widely used because it is reliable, secure, flexible, and cost-effective, making it one of the most popular cloud platforms in the world.
